title: Donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation
description: Anthropic announced it is donating Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation. The move places the skills format under neutral, open governance.

title: Open call for guest investigators in the life sciences
description: Anthropic opened a call for guest investigators in the life sciences. The program invites researchers to work with the company on science applications of its models.

title: OpenAI working on new $30B raise at $1.25T valuation ahead of IPO
description: TechCrunch reports OpenAI is working on a new $30 billion raise at a $1.25 trillion valuation. The round comes ahead of a planned IPO.

title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
description: Uber is rolling out ChatGPT Work to all 30,000 of its employees. The deployment is a large enterprise adoption of OpenAI's workplace product.

title: OpenAI makes its Jev competitor widely available as decision model competition heats up
description: OpenAI made its competitor to Jev widely available. TechCrunch frames the release as part of intensifying competition among decision models.

title: Microsoft's Mustafa Suleyman says its AI outperforms doctors on hard cases as he chases 'medical superintelligence'
description: Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman says the company's AI outperforms doctors on hard diagnostic cases. He describes the work as a push toward 'medical superintelligence'.

title: 1Password launches a way for AI agents to log in on your behalf without seeing your password
description: 1Password launched a feature that lets AI agents log in to services for users without exposing their passwords. It targets a growing security concern as agents act on people's behalf.

title: Spotify's current AI bet is about being the music service that agents choose
description: Spotify is positioning itself to be the music service that AI agents select on users' behalf. TechCrunch describes this as the company's current AI strategy.
